title: Android Wear Complication displays "Null, Null" with NSClient follower
body:
Xdrip+ used as a Sync follower with NSClient app as local broadcaster. BG data displays on the phone app, on the Xdrip+ watchfaces, but not on the Xdrip+ Complication.

Logs sent from Xdrip+ app. I'm trying to pull logs from the watch itself, but haven't gotten adb connected from the phone as of yet.

Phone: Pixel XL, Android 8.1
Watch: Ticwatch e, AW 2.9.0.185193291

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6577649/36846701-ad061fc0-1d29-11e8-9019-8f35c2d2af2b.png)

I have tested this with G5 native on 21st Aug nightly and complications are working fine here. 

If you are not using the latest nightly please update to it and also uninstall and reinstall the app from your watch (if it is running AW2.0) as on android wear 2 the app doesn't automatically update.

Hi I'm seeing this as well. Using Xdrip+ 2020.11.27 on a Pixel 2 XL (running Android 11) with Android Wear on a Fossil Gen 5. 
Xdrip+ is configured with: Hardware data source: Nightscout follower; 'Download treatments' enabled. A separate NS client is not installed.

Xdrip+ displays BG data correctly on the phone, and on the xDrip Watchface. However, the xdrip+ watch complication shows 'Null', 'Null'.
